recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not rename descendent-of under FHIR-16321; any future spelling migration would need a separate Vocabulary work-group compatibility decision.
issue_request: FHIR-16321 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary issue asking to improve the ValueSet filter-operator concepts by replacing confusing bracketed explanations on is-a, descendent-of, and generalizes, and by fixing the descendent/descendant spelling.
initial_application: Git commit d9b7f401d2146e4e43872969de5f5488cef9ce8b, recorded in Jira as svn revision 14661, applied the clarification to the historical source/valueset/valueset-spreadsheet.xml. A follow-up commit, f03d0a490a047136415aa5c435af2ff32cd182e4, reversed the code-value rename and added compatibility spelling guidance.
additional_context: The relevant built source has since moved to XML resources under source/valueset/. ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini, and ValueSet.compose.include.filter.op plus CodeSystem.filter.operator bind to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/filter-operator. Later FHIR-39264 corrected a parenthesis issue in the same definition family, and FHIR-49057 confirmed that descendent-of is normative/backward-compatible and should not be renamed.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/valueset/codesystem-filter-operator.xml already defines is-a as descendant codes plus self, descendent-of as descendant codes only, and generalizes as ancestor codes plus self; the remaining spelling is intentional. Adding only the omitted 'i.e.' before the is-a parenthetical would be non-semantic editorial polish below the source-edit threshold.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive correction fixed the missing descendent-of parenthesis while preserving the code spelling boundary; already represented separately on the combined branch.
Later Resolved - No Change question confirmed that descendent-of is normative/backward-compatible and should not be renamed.
